headline: Broad egress plus vendor-hosted browsing creates medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risk; no direct filesystem conflict is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: aci can ingest external content via APIs/MCP and has broad network egress, while Perplexity performs live web search and multi-hop browsing. That creates a plausible path where Perplexity-produced content is fed into aci as instructions or data without provenance checks. No shared filesystem is shown, so this is not high.
conditions: IF Perplexity output is copied into aci tool inputs without provenance filtering
IF aci parses retrieved text as instructions rather than data
mitigations: Add a provenance banner to all Perplexity outputs before handoff
Require manual review of any web-derived text before aci consumes it
Restrict aci prompts to structured fields only
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and instruction/data separation
requires-engineering: log and block untrusted tool-output directives

B_data_leakage.rationale: aci touches CRM, email, calendar, and customer support data, while Perplexity can analyze uploaded documents and browsing context with vendor egress. If sensitive aci data is pasted or uploaded into Perplexity, it can leave the local environment and be processed by a third party. The profiles do not show a shared workspace, so the risk is mediated by operator transfer.
conditions: IF CRM, email, or customer-support content from aci is uploaded into Perplexity
IF Perplexity is used on documents containing sensitive lead or customer data
mitigations: Redact sensitive fields before upload
Use Perplexity only on synthetic or public documents
Disable copying raw CRM/email text into search prompts
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on uploads and pasted text
requires-engineering: segregate sensitive aci workflows from vendor-hosted search

C_capability_conflict.rationale: aci can make direct function calls to many SaaS APIs and supports multiple instances, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted with no host execution, no filesystem write, and no git modification. The overlap is mostly read/query style rather than shared mutable state, so write-write conflict is limited. Uncertainty is low because the profiles explicitly deny the main conflict surfaces on Perplexity.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable SaaS resource through aci APIs
IF the operator manually duplicates edits across both agents
mitigations: Assign one agent as the sole writer per resource
Use separate API credentials for each workflow
Pause one agent before bulk edits in the other
requires-engineering: add resource-level locking
requires-engineering: add optimistic concurrency checks

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity is a search-RAG system that produces cited answers, and aci can act on outputs through integrations like email, Slack, CRM, and calendar. If aci treats Perplexity answers as authoritative, a mistaken search result can cascade into downstream actions. The pair lacks a built-in verification bridge in the profiles, so the default path is risky but not automatically destructive.
conditions: IF aci uses Perplexity answers as source-of-truth without human verification
IF Perplexity output is forwarded into email, CRM, or calendar actions
mitigations: Require human approval before any aci action based on Perplexity output
Cross-check critical facts against a second source
Limit aci to drafting, not sending or committing
requires-engineering: add confidence thresholds before action execution
requires-engineering: attach source citations to every downstream action

E_compliance.rationale: aci touches email, CRM, customer support, and calendar data, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted and can process uploaded documents and browsing context. That creates a plausible retention/residency mismatch for regulated customer data if operators move it into Perplexity. The profiles do not specify HIPAA/GDPR/DPA terms, so uncertainty pushes this to medium rather than low.
conditions: IF EU personal data or customer support records from aci are uploaded to Perplexity
IF retention or deletion requirements apply to the transferred documents
mitigations: Avoid uploading regulated data to Perplexity
Strip identifiers before search
Use Perplexity only for public or anonymized material
requires-engineering: document residency and retention boundaries
requires-engineering: add a DPA and data-class policy gate
